en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Kuwait–Czech Republic treaty provides a 0 per cent source-State rate for the qualifying Article 10 public-body exemption and a 5 per cent ceiling in all other treaty cases, where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. The official Kuwait–Czech Republic treaty provides residence-State-only taxation for interest beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State, subject to the permanent-establishment effective-connection exception and the treaty’s arm’s-length limitation. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. The official Kuwait–Czech Republic treaty provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling on royalties where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.
